build-web.description: Build the production web renderer once for Node render and browser gates.

build-desktop.description: Build the Electron renderer once for desktop gates and packaging.

typecheck.description: Run the TypeScript compiler without emitting files.

dependency-audit.description: Reject unreviewed or expired npm security advisories.

node-targeted.description: Run only the Node test files selected by the impact map.

node-core.description: Run core logic and invariant Node tests, excluding source-string contracts and heavy integration gates.

node-contract.description: Run implementation-shape contracts only when their owned UI or controller changes.

node-integration.description: Run Bridge, filesystem, schema, lifecycle and rendered-output integration tests.

node-package.description: Run package manifest and packaged-artifact verifier contracts.

node-smoke.description: Run a fixed fast cross-section of source patch, scope and product-contract Node tests.

node-full.description: Run every top-level Node test exactly once.

browser-smoke.description: Union of original Browser canaries selected by @gate-smoke. Ready PRs still run browser-full.

browser-full.description: Run the complete real Chromium editing suite with retries disabled.

real-html.description: Run the discovery-based real-HTML island byte/geometry oracle and the opt-in all-host operation census.

electron-smoke.description: Union of original Electron canaries selected by @gate-smoke. Ready PRs still run electron-full.

electron-full.description: Run the complete Electron editing suite, including disk persistence and cold reopen.

ai-closed-loop.description: Run the deterministic Electron comment-to-AI finalizer closed loop and failure paths.

ai-smoke.description: Union of original AI closed-loop canaries selected by @gate-smoke.

browser-editing-smoke.description: Capability canary for native editing, source bytes, IME and island entry.

browser-comments-smoke.description: Capability canary for comment rail, targeting and tab grouping.

browser-review-smoke.description: Capability canary for review comment binding and runtime projection.

browser-notification-smoke.description: Capability canary for notice recovery, keyboard dismissal and page preservation.

electron-editing-smoke.description: Capability canary for authored DOM input, disposable Edit runtime rerender and persisted composition.

electron-project-lifecycle-smoke.description: Capability canary for import, project switch and Finder rename.

electron-recovery-smoke.description: Capability canary for crash, replaced Working Copy and external-write recovery.

electron-agent-smoke.description: Capability canary for desktop Agent delivery from a real first-launch path.

ai-review-smoke.description: Capability canary for pending review, related-edit acceptance and candidate adoption.

ai-provider-smoke.description: Capability canary for Agent provider availability and ACP runtime wiring.

ai-run-lifecycle-smoke.description: Capability canary for Request identity, unknown outcome and clipboard-failure recovery.

package-build.description: Build the requested macOS candidate without rebuilding the renderer.

developer-package-build.description: Build one distinctly named and versioned ad-hoc macOS developer preview DMG from the exact clean tree.

developer-packaged-verify.description: Verify developer preview identity, app.asar, Bridge resources, schemas, ad-hoc signature and DMG integrity.

developer-packaged-startup.description: Launch the developer preview with isolated data and prove app name, version, first window, readiness and clean exit.

developer-package-report.description: Bind the developer installer to its exact source range and current GitHub Pull Request inventory for delivery.

candidate-app-build.description: Assemble the formal candidate app without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.

candidate-app-verify.description: Verify candidate app contents and dependency closure before release credentials are used.

candidate-app-runtime.description: Run the full packaged runtime oracle against the verified pre-sign candidate app.

packaged-runtime.description: Launch the packaged .app with isolated data and verify source bytes, stale-draft reconciliation and clean close/reopen.

packaged-verify.description: Verify app.asar, Bridge resources, schemas, signature, DMG integrity and read-only mount contents.

package-delivery-report.description: Bind the formal installer to its exact source range and current GitHub Pull Request inventory for delivery.

edit.description: Fast feedback while editing; only impacted Node tests and explicitly mapped compiler checks.

task.description: End-of-task gate; adds static checks and impacted browser, Electron or AI smoke coverage.

main.description: Optional diagnostic smoke for an exact main tree; automatic post-merge CI uses provenance verification only.

release.description: Fully automated pre-package release gate against one source state.

developer-package.description: Optional on-demand developer preview from one clean committed source state.

candidate-app.description: Internal exact-tree pre-sign app gate used by the formal release candidate workflow.

artifact.description: Release gate plus package build, packaged runtime smoke and artifact verification.
